meta.playoffDefinition: Scheduled games by the playoff field, including placement games; byes and consolation teams excluded.
meta.currentDefinition: 2026 rules applied to reconstructed historical NFL statistics, using original starters and positional eligibility. Potential Points reselects the highest-scoring legal lineup. The current season uses recorded MFL scores. Historical positions absent from 2026 rules, including KR, are unsupported and omitted.

overlay.label: Existing ADL26 historical reconstructed scoring overlay; estimates, not original MFL results

statLines.source: Cached nflverse player-week statistics joined using the audited season-specific GSIS/MFL ID maps; 2022 BUF/CIN replacement statistics use Week 18.

scoringBreakdowns.method: Same event rules, per-event rounding and display order as CHI Team Tools; captured MFL events are distinct from the NFL-stat reconstructed ranking estimates.
